references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, it is described how the cords of braided gold are to be made for the breastpiece, using the same expression 'braided work' (מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת).
A parallel text describing the actual making of the cords for the breastpiece, with the same description of braided work of pure gold.
Describes how the gold cords are to be attached to the breastpiece and the ephod, completing the instructions in verse 22.
The use of 'pure gold' (זָהָב טָהוֹר) is a recurring theme in the description of the sanctuary's furnishings.
Describes the braided work that serves as the necessary attachment point for the chains mentioned in the source verse.
Describes the final method of attaching the breastpiece to ensure it does not come loose from the ephod, thus completing the function of the chains.
